mealCandidate: known meal type, valid local timestamp, five finite nonnegative nutrients, kcal > 0; candidate is not a validated recommendation or CGM outcome
mealFlags: all-zero nutrition, fiber > carbs, published dictionary range exceeded, missing image, missing nutrients; amount unit is a separate participant-level status and is always unverified
amountConsumed: raw text only; participant-level heuristic unit status, never normalize as percent or multiply nutrients
glucose: retain two published interpolated minute grids separately; flag outside 40..400 mg/dL without clipping; no response/benefit labels
lifeActivityCandidate: steps >= 0, bpm > 0, all four activity-minute fields present and nonnegative, total <= 1440; no full-wear claim

lifeNumericBounds.default: finite nonnegative numeric values; invalid cells blanked with raw value in issues.jsonl
lifeNumericBounds.basis: nonnegative count/duration/energy domains, saturation/efficiency/score 0..100 and component fraction 0..1; no clinical extreme clipping
lifeNumericBounds.zeroStress: retain 0 as an unverified score and flag; do not infer it means absence of stress

untypedMealFields: preserve any nutrient/amount/image/sugar values with empty Meal Type in a separate sidecar with all raw fields; not counted as typed meals
lifeTime: strict local date and integer-valued hour 0..23, no UTC conversion or timezone inference; off-campaign dates retained with flag
dedup: same table and participant/time key; compare all source payload strings except export index; identical payload merges all source row numbers, conflicting key quarantines entire group
missing: no imputation; absent columns counted separately from empty cells
scope: CGMacros all CSV tables and image references; LifeSnaps all seven CSV tables; BSON and images preserved in original ZIP without conversion
